purpose: Capture a crisis rule that becomes permanent by being amended and grafted into an older standing Regulation, while preserving the distinction between genealogy, canonical target identity and substantive mutation.

provisions: Article 27 — Default rules for solidarity measures
Article 28 — Procedure for solidarity measures in the absence of a solidarity agreement

permanent_target.identity_note: The current permanent rule is canonically located in amended Regulation (EU) 2017/1938. Regulation (EU) 2024/1789 is the amending instrument, not a substitute identity for the hosted provision.

source_evidence.observation: The successor legislation expressly states that additional solidarity measures introduced as crisis measures by Regulation (EU) 2022/2576 are among the measures transformed into permanent features.
The act inserts paragraphs 8a, 8b and 8c into Article 13 of Regulation (EU) 2017/1938.

handoff.evidence: Regulation (EU) 2023/2919 extends Regulation (EU) 2022/2576 through 31 December 2024; Regulation (EU) 2024/1789 Article 89(2)(a) makes Article 84 apply from 1 January 2025.

preserved_core.temporary: Default rules apply where two Member States have not agreed the necessary solidarity arrangements.
Day-ahead market price in the providing Member State or corresponding closest accessible market/hub.
preserved_core.permanent: The same core day-ahead market-price hierarchy is retained.

preserved_core.temporary: Article 28 requires authority/operator contacts, delivery period and points, volume and gas quality.
preserved_core.permanent: Article 13(8b) retains the same core request-data fields.

substantive_mutations.temporary: At least 72 hours before indicated delivery time.
substantive_mutations.permanent: At least 48 hours before indicated delivery time.

substantive_mutations.temporary: Confirmation within 24 hours of the delivery time needed.
substantive_mutations.permanent: Confirmation within six hours of receipt of the offer and at least 24 hours before indicated delivery.

substantive_mutations.temporary: Article 27 limits other indirect costs to 100% of the gas price by default, with a Commission route for a higher amount.
substantive_mutations.permanent: Article 13(8a) retains indirect costs but no longer states that 100% default cap.

substantive_mutations.temporary: No equivalent Article 13(8c) regulatory ex-post control layer in the temporary default-rule package.
substantive_mutations.permanent: New Article 13(8c) subjects final compensation to ex-post control by national regulatory authorities, with an ACER role where needed.

architecture_result.statement: Direct genealogy, canonical rule identity and textual/substantive continuity remain separate. A temporary rule can be permanently grafted into an older host while being materially revised during transplantation.
forbidden_shortcuts: The permanent solidarity rule is canonically Regulation (EU) 2024/1789 Article 84 rather than the amended Regulation (EU) 2017/1938 Article 13.
Permanentisation means Regulation (EU) 2022/2576 itself remained in force.
Direct genealogy means the permanent rule is a verbatim copy.
Shared compensation categories imply every compensation condition survived unchanged.
A consolidated current Article 13 reveals its 2022 crisis ancestry without amendment/genealogy evidence.
